title: The Red Tartan Christmas Morning Waffle Breakfast
description: A red tartan Christmas morning breakfast from Walmart: the Dash Christmas tree mini waffle maker, the Better Homes & Gardens Holiday Plaid dinnerware set and oval platter, a Holiday Time Christmas sweater mug, a GoodCook glass syrup dispenser and a plaid table runner.
intro: Christmas morning breakfast should not require a culinary degree. It should require one tiny waffle maker that makes Christmas trees and a table that looks like you tried way harder than you did. That's this whole setup. Red tartan plates and a matching platter, a sweater mug for the cocoa, a syrup jug that doesn't drip all over the runner, and the little green Dash that turns boxed batter into tiny trees. Everybody eats in pajamas. Nobody cares about the crumbs.

paragraphs: The Better Homes & Gardens Holiday Plaid 12-piece dinnerware set, the matching Holiday Plaid oval stoneware serving platter, and the Sm:)e farmhouse plaid Christmas table runner in red multicolor, 13 by 36 inches.
